.github/workflows/validation.yml.note: Per-PR CI running the same integrity check and validation runner. repair-n1/N2: receipt path read via os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'] inside the quoted heredoc. P2-R2: strict report consumer step enforces the ok_platform_scoped/default-scope contract (sole P2-L09-native pending gate, full=false, platform=true, no unexpected/unapproved skips). P2-R3: consumer hardened to independently recompute the report — strict JSON (duplicate keys/nonfinite rejected), present+typed fields, non-bool nonnegative integer counts, framework reconciliation (was_successful/outcomes/testsRun==tests_run==len(entries)/skipped==1), per-entry unique-id + category tally equal to counters with zero failed, declared H9-only known_baseline_defect pairs, fixture_events empty/failure_events 0, only parent-matched subtest_success events, and the exact approved-skip rule string — no trust in accounting.errors or top-level summaries. P2-R4: three consumer consistency holes closed — known_baseline_defect requires the exact (test, defect=H9, gate=P3) triple per regression_inventory (arbitrary nonempty gate rejected); subtest ids must match the complete emitted parent + ' (' + nonempty + ')' shape (unclosed/empty/wrong-prefix rejected, no repr parsing); the exact native withheld skip parent may carry no subtest events at all. All prior strict JSON/type/framework/entries/fixture/gate checks preserved. P2-R5: H9 required-presence invariant enforced independently of supplied totals — exact test id must occur exactly once carrying category known_baseline_defect + defect H9 + gate P3; runtime.known_baseline_defects pinned to integer 1; relabel/ missing/substitute/duplicate with favorable counters all reject.
